purpose: Cross-sweep working ledger for Phase 8.4 fall-camp QB monitoring AND the input consumed by the Phase 8.4A candidate-build pipeline. One row per exception team once a sweep produces a meaningful update. The apply pipeline acts ONLY on rows whose resolution_status == 'APPROVED'.
status: EMPTY - no resolutions yet. No research performed. First sweep window: 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-05.

field_documentation.abbrev: Canonical abbreviation (matches QB VALUES / tracker). Required by the apply pipeline.
field_documentation.sweep_date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD of the sweep on which this row was recorded (monitoring context).
field_documentation.current_leader: Named/leading QB, or blank if undecided - monitoring context.
field_documentation.resolution_status: UNRESOLVED | PROPOSED-DEVIATION | APPROVED. The apply pipeline acts ONLY on APPROVED.
field_documentation.confidence: H / M / L. Apply requires H or M.
field_documentation.baseline_qb: Preseason baseline QB (the zero reference). Required (apply).
field_documentation.active_qb: The QB the Active value describes. Required (apply).
field_documentation.active_value: 0 for zero-init; an APPROVED quarter-point deviation in [-4.00,+2.00] for a baseline mismatch (needs a matching approved review-log record).
field_documentation.source_date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; blank only if the exact date is unavailable - but apply requires it populated to write a row.
field_documentation.zero_init_justified: Y if resolved Active QB == baseline and no unresolved issue.
field_documentation.nonzero_adjustment_possible: Y if the resolved Active QB differs materially from baseline (route to qb_deviation_review_log; propose - do not enter - a deviation).

rules: The apply pipeline writes a row only when resolution_status == APPROVED and every apply-input field validates.
zero_init (baseline_qb == active_qb): baseline_value and active_value must both be 0.

baseline mismatch (baseline_qb != active_qb): active_value must be an APPROVED quarter-point deviation in [-4.00,+2.00] with a matching approved record in qb_deviation_review_log; otherwise the row is rejected and stays UNCERTAIN.
Never enter a nonzero value without explicit approval; the ADJUSTMENTS sheet must never be used as a substitute.
Injury cases require credible evidence of normal participation or confirmed game availability before clearing.
